column1: breathe|/briːð/|v.|呼吸；吸入|基础|breathe|breathe deeply::深呼吸;breathe fresh air::呼吸新鲜空气|It is easier to breathe when the air is clean.::空气清洁时，呼吸会更顺畅。|Take a moment to breathe deeply before you speak.::开口说话前，花一点时间深呼吸。

breath|/breθ/|n.|呼吸；一口气；气息|基础|breathe|take a breath::吸一口气;out of breath::上气不接下气|She stopped to take a breath after climbing the stairs.::爬上楼梯后，她停下来喘了口气。|I was out of breath when I reached the top.::到达顶端时，我已上气不接下气。

healthy|/ˈhelθi/|adj.|健康的；有益健康的|基础|health|a healthy diet::健康饮食;stay healthy::保持健康|A healthy diet includes a variety of foods.::健康饮食包含各种不同的食物。|Regular activity can help people stay healthy.::经常活动有助于人们保持健康。

illness|/ˈɪlnəs/|n.|疾病；生病的状态|基础|health|a serious illness::严重疾病;recover from an illness::病后康复|She missed several classes because of illness.::她因为生病缺了几节课。|The illness affected his ability to work for a while.::这场病一度影响了他的工作能力。

disease|/dɪˈziːz/|n.|疾病；病害|基础|health|prevent disease::预防疾病;a common disease::常见疾病|Scientists are studying how the disease spreads.::科学家正在研究这种疾病如何传播。|Clean drinking water helps prevent some diseases.::清洁的饮用水有助于预防某些疾病。

energy|/ˈenərdʒi/|n.|能量；精力；能源|基础|nature-resources|save energy::节约能源;renewable energy::可再生能源|The new lights use less energy than the old ones.::新灯比旧灯耗能更少。|I had little energy left after the long journey.::长途旅行后，我几乎没有剩余的精力了。

resource|/ˈriːsɔːrs/|n.|资源；可利用的资料或手段|四级|nature-resources|natural resources::自然资源;a useful resource::有用的资料|Water is a resource that we should use carefully.::水是一种我们应该谨慎使用的资源。|The library is a useful resource for independent study.::图书馆是自主学习的有用资源。

climate|/ˈklaɪmət/|n.|气候；风气；环境|基础|nature-resources|climate change::气候变化;a warm climate::温暖的气候|The island has a warm climate throughout the year.::这座岛全年气候温暖。|The study examines the effects of climate change on farming.::这项研究考察气候变化对农业的影响。

environment|/ɪnˈvaɪrənmənt/|n.|环境；周围的条件|基础|environment|protect the environment::保护环境;a learning environment::学习环境|Small daily choices can help protect the environment.::日常的小选择能够帮助保护环境。|Children need a safe environment in which to learn.::孩子们需要安全的学习环境。

environmental|/ɪnˌvaɪrənˈmentəl/|adj.|环境的；与自然环境有关的|六级|environment|environmental protection::环境保护;environmental impact::环境影响|The project includes an assessment of its environmental impact.::该项目包括一项环境影响评估。|Environmental protection requires cooperation between many groups.::环境保护需要许多群体之间的合作。

pollute|/pəˈluːt/|v.|污染；弄脏|基础|pollute|pollute the air::污染空气;pollute a river::污染河流|Waste from the factory can pollute the nearby river.::工厂的废物可能污染附近的河流。|We need cleaner ways to travel without polluting the air.::我们需要不会污染空气的更清洁的出行方式。

pollution|/pəˈluːʃən/|n.|污染；污染物造成的影响|基础|pollute|air pollution::空气污染;reduce pollution::减少污染|Air pollution has become a major concern in the city.::空气污染已成为这座城市的一大关切。|Better waste management can help reduce pollution.::更好的废物管理有助于减少污染。

recycle|/ˌriːˈsaɪkəl/|v.|回收利用；再利用|基础|nature-resources|recycle paper::回收纸张;recycle materials::回收利用材料|Our school encourages students to recycle paper and bottles.::我们学校鼓励学生回收纸张和瓶子。|Some materials are easier to recycle than others.::有些材料比其他材料更容易回收利用。

protect|/prəˈtekt/|v.|保护；防护|基础|protect|protect against::防范;protect from::使免受|These trees help protect the soil from heavy rain.::这些树有助于保护土壤免受大雨冲刷。|Wear suitable clothing to protect yourself against the cold.::穿上合适的衣服以抵御寒冷。

protection|/prəˈtekʃən/|n.|保护；防护措施|基础|protect|environmental protection::环境保护;protection from::免受……的保护|The shelter provides protection from wind and rain.::这个避雨处能遮风挡雨。|The new rules offer better protection for local wildlife.::新规定为当地野生动物提供了更好的保护。

nutrition|/nuːˈtrɪʃən/|n.|营养；营养摄取|基础|nutrition|good nutrition::良好营养;human nutrition::人类营养|The course explains the basic principles of human nutrition.::这门课程解释人类营养的基本原理。|Good nutrition supports growth and everyday activity.::良好的营养支持生长和日常活动。

nutrient|/ˈnuːtriənt/|n.|营养物质；养分|六级|nutrition|essential nutrients::必需营养素;absorb nutrients::吸收养分|Plants absorb nutrients from the soil through their roots.::植物通过根从土壤中吸收养分。|Different foods provide different kinds of nutrients.::不同的食物提供不同种类的营养物质。

metabolism|/məˈtæbəlɪzəm/|n.|新陈代谢|扩展|health|energy metabolism::能量代谢;the rate of metabolism::代谢速率|The researchers studied energy metabolism in the cells.::研究人员研究了细胞中的能量代谢。|Many factors can influence the rate of metabolism.::许多因素都可能影响代谢速率。

immune|/ɪˈmjuːn/|adj.|免疫的；不受影响的|六级|immune|the immune system::免疫系统;immune to::不受……影响的|The immune system helps the body respond to infection.::免疫系统帮助身体应对感染。|No organization is completely immune to criticism.::没有任何组织能完全免受批评。

immunity|/ɪˈmjuːnəti/|n.|免疫力；豁免|六级|immune|immunity to::对……的免疫力;diplomatic immunity::外交豁免|The study examined immunity to a particular virus.::这项研究考察了对某种病毒的免疫力。|Diplomatic immunity has limits set by international agreements.::外交豁免受到国际协议规定的限制。

diagnose|/ˌdaɪəɡˈnoʊs/|v.|诊断；判断问题所在|六级|diagnose|diagnose a disease::诊断疾病;diagnose a problem::判断问题所在|Doctors use several tests to diagnose the disease.::医生通过几项检查来诊断这种疾病。|The technician tried to diagnose the cause of the failure.::技术人员试图查明故障原因。

diagnosis|/ˌdaɪəɡˈnoʊsɪs/|n.|诊断；诊断结果|扩展|diagnose|an accurate diagnosis::准确的诊断;early diagnosis::早期诊断|An accurate diagnosis depends on reliable information.::准确的诊断依赖可靠的信息。|The report explains the reasoning behind the diagnosis.::报告解释了作出这一诊断的依据。

ecology|/ɪˈkɑːlədʒi/|n.|生态学；生态关系|基础|ecology|forest ecology::森林生态学;the study of ecology::生态学研究|Ecology examines the relationships between organisms and their environment.::生态学研究生物与其环境之间的关系。|She is studying forest ecology at university.::她正在大学学习森林生态学。

ecological|/ˌiːkəˈlɑːdʒɪkəl/|adj.|生态的；生态学的|扩展|ecology|ecological balance::生态平衡;ecological damage::生态破坏|The dam may affect the ecological balance of the river.::这座水坝可能影响河流的生态平衡。|The team assessed the ecological damage after the fire.::团队评估了火灾后的生态破坏。

ecosystem|/ˈiːkoʊsɪstəm/|n.|生态系统|六级|ecology|a marine ecosystem::海洋生态系统;a fragile ecosystem::脆弱的生态系统|A small change can affect the entire ecosystem.::一个小变化可能影响整个生态系统。|The island has a fragile ecosystem that needs protection.::这座岛拥有需要保护的脆弱生态系统。

biodiversity|/ˌbaɪoʊdaɪˈvɜːrsəti/|n.|生物多样性|扩展|diverse|protect biodiversity::保护生物多样性;marine biodiversity::海洋生物多样性|Protecting forests helps preserve biodiversity.::保护森林有助于维护生物多样性。|The survey recorded changes in marine biodiversity.::这项调查记录了海洋生物多样性的变化。

conserve|/kənˈsɜːrv/|v.|保护；节约使用|四级|conserve|conserve water::节约用水;conserve energy::节约能源|Simple habits can help conserve water at home.::简单的习惯就能帮助家庭节约用水。|The reserve was created to conserve rare species.::设立这一保护区是为了保护稀有物种。

conservation|/ˌkɑːnsərˈveɪʃən/|n.|保护；保存；节约|基础|conserve|wildlife conservation::野生动物保护;energy conservation::节约能源|Wildlife conservation often depends on protecting natural habitats.::野生动物保护往往依赖于保护自然栖息地。|The building was designed with energy conservation in mind.::这座建筑在设计时考虑了节能。

renewable|/rɪˈnuːəbəl/|adj.|可再生的；可续期的|扩展|nature-resources|renewable energy::可再生能源;a renewable contract::可续期的合同|The region is investing in renewable energy.::这一地区正在投资可再生能源。|The position comes with a renewable one-year contract.::这一职位提供可续签的一年期合同。

contaminate|/kənˈtæmɪneɪt/|v.|污染；使受污染|六级|nature-resources|contaminate water::污染水;contaminate a sample::使样本受到污染|Chemicals from the site could contaminate drinking water.::来自该地点的化学物质可能污染饮用水。|Use clean tools so that you do not contaminate the sample.::使用干净工具，以免污染样本。
